commit.commitDidNotCompleteYourDraftIsPr.en: Commit did not complete. Your draft is preserved.
commit.commitDidNotCompleteYourDraftIsPr.zh-CN: 提交未完成，草稿已保留。

commit.resolveAllConflictsBeforeCommit.zh-CN: 请先解决全部 {{conflicts}} 个冲突，再提交。

commit.stageChangesBeforeCommittingOrUse.en: Stage changes before committing, or use Amend to edit the last Commit message.
commit.stageChangesBeforeCommittingOrUse.zh-CN: 请先暂存更改再提交，或使用“修订提交”编辑上一次提交消息。

commit.draftsSaveAutomaticallyCancelEsca.en: Drafts save automatically. Cancel, Escape and Close keep your message.
commit.draftsSaveAutomaticallyCancelEsca.zh-CN: 草稿自动保存，取消、Esc 和关闭均保留 Message。

commit.stagedFilesDefault.en: All staged files selected by default
commit.stagedFilesDefault.zh-CN: 默认勾选全部已暂存文件

commit.combinedNotice.en: Combined includes both unstaged and staged changes in the same file.
commit.combinedNotice.zh-CN: 合并提交包含同一文件未暂存和已暂存更改。

commit.chooseFiles.en: Select at least one file to commit.
commit.chooseFiles.zh-CN: 请至少勾选一个提交文件。

commit.selectionChanged.en: The selected changes, branch or HEAD changed. Reopen Commit to review the files.
commit.selectionChanged.zh-CN: 所选更改、分支或 HEAD 已变化，请重新打开提交窗口核对文件。

commit.indexBusy.en: The Index is locked by another Git operation. Try again when it completes.
commit.indexBusy.zh-CN: 暂存区正被其他 Git 操作锁定，请待其完成后重试。

commit.indexPublishFailed.en: The commit was created, but updating the Index failed. Check HEAD and the Index before retrying.
commit.indexPublishFailed.zh-CN: 提交已创建，但更新暂存区失败。请先检查 HEAD 和暂存区，不要直接重试提交。

commit.selectionOperationBlocked.en: Commit Selected is unavailable during an active Git operation or conflicts. Review and commit the complete staged result.
commit.selectionOperationBlocked.zh-CN: 存在活动 Git 操作或冲突时无法提交所选文件，请检查并提交完整暂存结果。
